title: Durian Pancake Delight
description: A tropical twist on classic pancakes, featuring the unique flavor of durian and zanzibari spices.
instructions: Combine dry ingredients (pancakes) in a bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk together durian puree, eggs, milk, oil, and sugar.
Add zingy and zanzibari to the wet ingredients and mix well.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and mix until smooth.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Drop batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the pan.
Cook until bubbles appear on the surface and edges start to dry.
Flip and cook for another 1-2 minutes.
